entities.summary: Sergei Vitalievich Glushko is a Russian actor, singer and fitness model, known in the countries of the former USSR as a striptease dancer under the pseudonym of Tarzan and as the husband of Natasha Korolyova. He is the founder and creator of the first-ever male revue "Tarzan Dance Show" in Russia, which performs in Moscow, and tours all around the world. The show is a 60-minute interactive performance with choreographed dances, amazing music, costumes and lights. Their main competitor is Chippendales.
